subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian classical dancers, who popularised the Odissi dance form both in India and all over the world, received the honour of Padma Vibhushan in 2000?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelucharan Mohapatra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra was a legendary Indian classical dancer and a prominent Odissi dance teacher.
 
• He was born on 8th January 1926 and led this dancing talent toward great heights until his death on April 7, 2004.
 
• He is amazingly the** first-ever winner of the Padma Vibhushana Award from the state of Odisha.**
 
• He also got **Padma Bhushan (1988), Padma Shri (1974****), and Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (1966).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pankaj Charan Mohapatra:**

 
 
• Aptly appertained to as the ‘adiguru’ of Odissi, Guru Pankaj Charan Das was the practitioner of all the authors- fathers of Odissi cotillion – Kelucharan Mohapatra, Mayadhar Raut, and Debaprasad Das – piecemeal from the utmost of the coming generation of Odissi exponents who are internationally known moment.
 
• And ironically, he'd been the most obscure Odissi legend.
 
 
 
• **Rahul Acharya:**
 
 
• Dancer, choreographer, experimenter, Sanskrit scholar, speaker, and pen, Rahul Acharya was the 2014 philanthropist of the Aditya Vikram Birla Kalakiran Award.
 
• In 2013 he entered the Ram Gopal Award for Best Male Solo Dancer from the Dance History Society of India.
 
• Mr. Acharya came the first manly Odissi cotillion recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi with the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar Award in 2009.
 
 
 
• **Debasis Patnaik:**
 
 
• Debasis Patnaik( born 9 June 1967) is an Indian Politician from Odisha, Advocate, and Social Activist of character, who has served as a Member of the Legislative Assembly from Banki, Odisha, during 2004- 2009.
 
• He was formerly the Deputy Chief Whip of the Congress Legislature Party in Odisha Assembly 5 times during his stint as an MLA.
 
• He at present is serving as the Vice – chairman of the Pradesh Congress Committee, Odisha, and a Member of the All India Congress Committee( AICC).
